vision.name: Combination Drill
vision.text:
(Limit 1 per deck.)
[Continuous] POWER: When entering combat, choose a Drill not named "Combination Drill" and destroy it. Your opponent may choose a Drill not named "Combination Drill" and destroy it.
(Most Recent Printing)
